name: Kozue
source:
A genuine high school boy who always dresses up like a girl. Even when he does come to school, he just stays in the infirmary and shuts himself up.

He always tries to act cute, but has a foul mouth anyways. He likes older people and hates younger people.

[Translated from [url=http://b-cluster.eek.jp/requartz/character/kozue.html]official website[/url]]
